changes: First official version of the DragonBreak Online Server Rules, kept on the DragonBreak server and published on our website and in our Discord's #server-rules channel.
It replaces Blood and Law on the website, the Discord Rules in #welcome and the six #rp-rules threads, and adds the rules announced since.
New in section 3: one Discord account per person. Anyone who already has more than one opens a ticket by 4 November 2026 to choose the one to keep.
First official Staff Handbook for every rank. It replaces the Trial GM Handbook and the GM Handbook.
